description: Phase F follow-up experiments (conformal correction, within-slice refit, calibration-method comparison, uncertainty reporting)

split.note: identical to Phase E; Phase F never re-splits

preregistered_small_sample_rule.rule: use platt when n_development < n_threshold OR reliability_input_range < range_threshold; otherwise isotonic
preregistered_small_sample_rule.rationale: isotonic needs observations at the extremes of the reliability input to place its end knots; with a narrow range and few rows the end knots are supported by a handful of items and the map jumps to 0 or 1 on noise. Platt assumes a sigmoid shape and borrows strength across the range.
preregistered_small_sample_rule.note: the thresholds are proposed hyperparameters, not tuned values; they are chosen from the observed design (n=78, range 0.0795) and are not selected on holdout performance

experiment_2.comparison: stored pooled Phase E model vs the same estimator refitted on L1 development records only
experiment_2.eligibility: feature-complete for the legal head; both arms must produce a finite score; rule does not use correctness labels

uncertainty.note: items within an offence topic share legal facts and are matched L1/L7 pairs, so the topic is the sampling unit; item-level resampling is reported as a secondary, optimistic figure

gates.note: unchanged from the merged Phase F configuration; no follow-up experiment alters a gate
